contents.Text: [[[underline:Soft Purple]]] ≈ Name
[[[underline:Soft Yellow]]] ≈ Logo
[[[underline:Dark Blue]]] ≈ Version and Developer
[[[underline:Light Green]]] ≈ Config and Log Paths
[[[underline:Pale Orange]]] ≈ Find Me On
[[[underline:Soft Peach]]] ≈ Donations
[[[underline:Deep Green]]] ≈ Contributing and Download
[[[underline:Cyan Blue]]] ≈ Copyright Notice
[[[underline:Crimson Red]]] ≈ Backend Info
[[[underline:Deep Purple]]] ≈ Git Stats
Displays the name of the program, [[[strong:RhythmiRust]]].
Name comes from the combination of the words [[[strong:Rhythmic]]] and [[[hyperlink:Rust][https://rust-lang.org]]].
Displays the [[[strong:RhythmiRust]]] logo.
The logo is a cog with an audio waveform at its centre.
[[[strong:Version]]] shows the version of [[[strong:RhythmiRust]]] you are currently running.
[[[strong:Developed by]]] shows the name of the developer.
Shows where [[[strong:RhythmiRust]]] stores its files on your system.
[[[strong:Config path]]] is the location of the configuration folder.
[[[strong:Log path]]] is the location of the log file.
[[[warning:Note:]]] The paths shown will differ depending on your system and how the program was installed.
[[[warning:Note:]]] You can [[[strong:double click]]] to select the entire line and then press [[[strong:Ctrl + C]]] to copy the entire path.
[[[warning:Note:]]] No need to stretch the window to copy the entire path.
Links for contacting the developer through [[[strong:GitHub]]], [[[strong:Email]]] and [[[strong:Discord]]].
Links for supporting the developer through donations.
[[[strong:Bitcoin]]] and [[[strong:Ethereum]]] are currently available.
[[[strong:Contributing]]] links to the [[[strong:Wiki]]].
[[[strong:Download]]] links to the main program on [[[strong:GitHub]]].
Displays the copyright notice for the project.
Shows the graphics backend that [[[strong:RhythmiRust]]] is currently using, along with any other backends listed beside [[[strong:Others]]].
Click the arrow to expand or collapse this section.
Hover over the current backend, or any of the others, to display more details about the renderer and the device being used.
The details shown include the following:
[[[strong:• Backend]]] The renderer that is in use.
[[[strong:• Device Type]]] The type of device, for example [[[strong:DiscreteGpu]]].
[[[strong:• Name]]] The name of the device.
[[[strong:• Driver]]] and [[[strong:Driver info]]] The driver and its version information.
[[[strong:• Vendor]]] and [[[strong:Device]]] The vendor and device identifiers.
[[[strong:• PCI Bus ID]]] The location of the device on the PCI bus.
[[[strong:• Subgroup size]]] The subgroup size range reported by the device.
[[[strong:• Transient saves memory]]] and [[[strong:Limit bucket]]] Additional device information.
[[[warning:Note:]]] The details shown will differ depending on your hardware and the backend you hover over.
Shows statistics from the project's Git history.
Click the arrow to expand or collapse this section.
Statistics for every contributor combined.
Statistics for each individual contributor, ranked with the highest at the top.
Each entry shows the contributor's name and their rank.
Both sections display the following:
[[[strong:• Commits]]] The number of commits.
[[[strong:• Insertions]]] and [[[strong:Deletions]]] The number of lines added and removed.
[[[strong:• Lines changed]]] The total number of lines changed.
[[[strong:• Files changed]]], [[[strong:Files created]]] and [[[strong:Files deleted]]] The number of files affected.
[[[strong:• First commit]]] and [[[strong:Last commit]]] The date and time of the earliest and latest commits.
[[[strong:• Average lines changed per commit]]] The average number of lines changed in each commit.
[[[strong:Total Project Stats]]] also shows [[[strong:Total Contributors/People]]].
